Aradhya — original art kit

55 original SVGs, one per row of assets/manifest.json, drawn to replace the PLACEHOLDER-ISHVARVAANI art that build.py --strict refuses to ship. Checkerboard = transparent. Each caption gives the asset slot it replaces.
